name: Disneyland & DCA Jumbo Smoked Turkey Leg (Eat Lean Inner Meat, Remove Skin)
brandOrRestaurant: Edelweiss Snacks, Ship to Shore & Poultry Palace (Disneyland & DCA)
whyItWorks: 100% pure smoked dark-meat turkey with 0g carbs, 0g fiber, and 0g dairy; tearing off the tough smoky skin and eating a normal 4–6 oz portion of the tender inner meat gives you huge protein and sodium electrolytes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off the tough outer smoked skin, pull the tender dark meat off the tendons, and share the giant 1.5-lb leg with family.
watchOuts: High in cured sodium (helpful on hot park days) and smoky skin—always discard the skin and tough tendons
